preview_email.subject: Blocked kitchen drain at Le Petit Zinc?
preview_email.body:
Hi Marie,

When a kitchen drain blocks in the middle of service, every minute costs covers. Dutrou unblocks restaurant drains in Paris the same day.

Worth keeping our number for the next time?

The Dutrou team

complete_sign_in.note: This conversation is now tied to this account. Right after this reply you answer again, automatically, with its access: here just say in a few words that they are in. Never ask them to send anything to continue.
complete_sign_in.plan: The plan built in this conversation (dutrou.com) is now in this account.

facts: This person has no distribute.you account yet.
What distribute.you offers is on its public site (https://distribute.you/llms.txt, /catalog, /terms): read it with read_our_website, whatever it says is true.

Before any account, the assistant builds the person's plan right in this conversation from their website, with its API tools, on a draft opened for this conversation: brand, offer, who to reach, sample companies, a sample email (each step's answer is in the tool answers). Paying and launching need their account: their email and the 6-digit code sent to it, in this conversation (on the website also a phone number for urgent matters); the plan then becomes theirs.
Their brand Dutrou was set up from dutrou.com this conversation; the offers proposed are in the tool answers.
expect: Keeps the offer they chose and moves their plan on in this same turn (who to reach, sample companies, a sample email, as far as the tools go), saying what it picked. Does not ask for their email or an account yet: nothing here needs one. Ends on one next step.
